results.name: VITE_TEEN_MASTER_OF_BUSINESS_WEBHOOK
results.reply:
The Teen Master of Business Programme aims to teach a 15-year-old student various essential business skills and concepts. Here are some key aspects of what a 15-year-old student can learn from the programme:

- Your child will learn about the entrepreneurial mindset, opportunity recognition, creative thinking, and developing a growth mindset.
- They will understand markets, target customers, perform market research, and build customer personas.
- The programme covers building a business model, financial aspects such as understanding business numbers, marketing strategies, branding, and sustainable business practices.
- Students will also gain leadership skills, learn about digital business tools, AI for business, ethics, sustainable business practices, and hone communication and negotiation skills.
- The curriculum includes practical activities, case studies, real-world examples, and a capstone project where students launch and manage a real micro-enterprise.

The programme is designed to provide practical exposure and learning experiences for young entrepreneurs, helping them develop crucial business acumen and skills in a supportive educational environment.
